heading_path: PR-07: Admission Casebook A (PAT-007, PAT-008, PAT-009, PAT-010)
evidence.evidence_text: DG-01 recommends a renin-angiotensin system blocker after ACS when LVEF is below 50% or hypertension persists. For PAT-008 the standard choice, an ACE inhibitor such as lisinopril (MED-004), is **contraindicated by ALG-004** (MP-01, MP-06, MP-07). MP-01 also advises caution with related receptor-blocking agents after ACE-inhibitor angioedema. No renin-angiotensin agent was started; blood pressure was addressed with metoprolol and cardiology re-review planned at 6 weeks (completed 2026-03-17, BP 132/80). Discharged 2026-02-07. Compare PAT-001 (PR-01), who takes lisinopril without any allergy flag.
